primary.disposition: Actual private module and factory/export checked.

Cold source map moves into SHA256-keyed runtime state with precomputed anonymous-forward policy. Ordered variant-restricted source extraction borrows selected descriptor; first invalid key rejects without trying later source or anonymous. Canonical sensitive identity/header/challenge/delay and decoded query/raw multi-line cookie stripping retain semantics. Short extraction loops differ by policy and do not justify another common-session helper.

support_scope: Relevant original timing/identity/extraction/strip decisions personally read. Actual cold validation/secrets, shared diagnostics/delivery/typed mutation, source generation/format/credential-order and redaction regression sections read. Supporting files selected sections; no automatic primary credit.
limits: Static only; no tests/builds, crypto oracle execution, timing guarantee/measurements, full Controller secret parser coverage or new globally reserved headers.
